comment: Добрый дом WOW cover rules — Cover-QA FAIL if broken. Logo: cover always + 2-3 inlines only, TOP-RIGHT pad.
utility_test: Inline must teach OR show lived-in comfort+ OR infographic utility. Pure decorative icon row = FAIL.
style_lock: WOW magazine poster cover + high-key #FFFFFF utility inlines. ONE small official logo TOP-RIGHT on cover + 2-3 inlines only (factory paste). NO overlapping zones.
forbidden_inline: two or more logos on one frame
decorative icon row without lived-in scene
